Keep secrets, personal information and private Project data out of this report. Follow SECURITY.md for security concerns; share only a sanitized summary without confidential exploit details.

Planning type does not assign a Story Map level or a native GitHub Issue type.

## Capability and outcome

What capability should this Feature provide, and what outcome does it enable?

## Success criteria

Which observable conditions show that the capability is complete?

## Context and references (optional)

Link related planning items, dependencies and source evidence. Map placement is a separate decision.
